Lower window node

Source: R/lower.R
lower_window.Rd

Binds every spec's value_col/order_cols (and the node's own group_cols) to 0-based indices against ast$input's schema, groups the specs into "frames" keyed by (order_cols, order_desc), and hands ONE gpu_window() call (src/ops_window.cpp) to the C++ side: the six-step stable-sort / gather / groupby-scan-or-shift / scatter-back algorithm.

Usage

lower_window(ast, source_ptr)

Details

out_pos (each spec's 0-based position among the node's own appended columns) is simply the spec's position in ast$specs – the same order infer_schema.ast_window() (R/ast.R) appends spec output columns in, so the two always agree on where a given spec's result lands in the final schema.

Every window kind is lowerable: the "shift" family (lag()/lead()), the "scan" family (cumsum()/cummax()/ cummin()/cumprod(), plus bare row_number()'s no-order COUNT_ALL form), the "rank" family (row_number(x)/min_rank()/dense_rank()/ percent_rank()/cume_dist()), and the "agg" family (mean()/sum()/min()/max()/n()/sd()/var()/first()/ last()/nth()) – see validate_window_spec() – plus the "rolling" family (roll_mean()/roll_sum()/roll_min()/roll_max()/roll_sd(), but NOT roll_median() – see window_spec_lowerable()'s own docs). A spec whose fn isn't recognized AT ALL (no registry entry, or a registry entry with a NULL window field) hits a hard internal error here (never a user-facing message: no verb decomposes an expression into an unrecognized spec, so reaching this function with one is a cuplyr bug, not a user mistake).
